title: Nanoflower-shaped cobalt-metal–organic framework as an oxidase-like nanozyme and 1,2-diaminobenzene as a catalytic substrate for the innovative signal “off-on” aptamer sensing of prostate-specific antigen
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,23288-23294
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01552B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Chen Ji, Yi Zhang, Xingtian Wang, Pingying Xie, Shaoting Wu, Yanfang Zheng, Mingqing Huang
In this work, an innovative “off-on” sensing strategy controlled by Apt was developed for the detection of PSA based on a Co-MOF nanohybrid, and the proposed sensor exhibited excellent detection performance.
